hero.title_highlight: We make sure you get paid.
hero.subtitle: Kalmed Billing is a full-service, AI enabled medical billing partner for independent practices and specialty clinics. We levearge the latest technologies and platforms to handle claims, denials, and the entire revenue cycle, so your staff can focus on care instead of paperwork.

services.heading: Billing at the core, support across the whole practice
services.subheading: Claims, denials, and the full revenue cycle, plus practice management, revenue consulting, and healthcare technology guidance for practices that want one partner for the business side of medicine.

items.title: Claims Submission & Scrubbing
items.text: Clean claims go out fast and get paid the first time. We scrub every claim for coding errors, missing modifiers, and payer-specific rules before submission.

items.title: Denial Management & Appeals
items.text: Denials get worked, not written off. Our team tracks every denial to its root cause, files timely appeals, and feeds the fixes back into your front-end process.

items.title: Revenue Cycle Management
items.text: Full-cycle coverage: charge entry, payment posting, A/R follow-up, and monthly reporting that shows you exactly where every dollar stands.

items.title: Practice Management
items.text: Front- and back-office operations that run like clockwork. We help with staffing workflows, scheduling, and day-to-day process design so your office keeps pace with your revenue cycle.

items.title: Revenue Consulting
items.text: Performance analysis, payer contract strategy, and growth planning. We benchmark your numbers against your specialty and build a practical plan to capture more of what you earn.

items.title: Healthcare Technology Consulting
items.text: EHR selection and optimization, systems integration, and workflow automation. We help you choose, implement, and get real value from the technology your practice runs on.

contact.heading: Let's talk about your revenue
contact.subtext: Reach out for a free audit, a pricing quote, or just a straight answer about whether outsourcing makes sense for your practice.
